t: This is the Plimsoll Memorial, a Grade II listed monument on the Victoria Embankment, just outside Victoria Embankment Gardens. It was erected in 1929 and made by the sculptor Ferdinand Victor Blundstone, who was born in Switzerland and worked in England. It remembers Samuel Plimsoll, a politician and social reformer best known for devising the Plimsoll line. Once it became regulation, ship sinkings fell and seafarers became much safer from the late nineteenth century onwards.
